paused_reason: The week-4 scan produced FALSE data and an unsafe recommended action. Verified against live `gh` on 2026-07-27: xpaysh/awesome-x402 #649 was MERGED 2026-07-17, but the scan reported it stale and drafted a 'FINAL CHANCE ... closing' comment for it. Posting that would have put a closing threat on a merged PR. The scan also claimed 'zero follow-ups have been sent', contradicted by saneGuy bump comments on #1016, #22, #91 and #453. Root cause is stated in the scan's own note: GitHub MCP is scoped to bolyra/bolyra, so external PR state was INFERRED from opening dates rather than checked. This repeats the lesson already recorded in tasks/lessons.md (2026-07-14, robinhood#20): sweep merged/closed states, not just open.
unpause_requirements: Query live PR state per PR (`gh pr view <n> --repo <r> --json state,mergedAt,comments,reviews`) instead of inferring from opening dates.
Treat MERGED and CLOSED as terminal: never draft a follow-up, bump, or closing comment for a PR in either state.
Read review bodies as well as issue comments; a maintainer approval often lives in .reviews[], not .comments[].
Distinguish OUR comments from maintainer comments before claiming 'zero contact'. Bot comments (CLA, stale-bot, coderabbitai) are not engagement.
Reconcile the scorecard against live state at the start of every scan rather than accumulating it.
